primary_layer: reviewed_clauses: existing selected comparison documents; national condition sample89, jurisdictions117. No new source automatically replaces an existing selected version.
supplemental_layer: supplemental_reviewed_clauses: additional exact passages admitted after raw-byte, decoded-text and substring-offset validation. Can include operative rules, guidance, mirrored regulations, drafts, historical surveys, limited access and registration baselines.

fields.raw_sha256: SHA256 of the original downloaded file bytes
fields.text_sha256: SHA256 of UTF8-encoded decoded source text with LF newlines; offsets apply to this text
fields.start_offset: Zero-based inclusive character offset in preserved decoded text
fields.legal_type: Source genre/status; guidance and drafts are not silently treated as binding law
fields.scope: Products, procedures or access function discussed
fields.reported_operative_date: Date reported by source, where established; retained as metadata only in this supplemental pass
fields.historical_backfill_permitted: False for all supplemental passages in this pass
fields.selected_primary_document: False; does not add condition counts to the89-source comparison
fields.parallel_review_status: Contextual scope resolution/partial review/pending; does not imply the whole original PDF was read
fields.reviewed_ranges: Actual character ranges inspected; partial documents remain in the resume queue

translation_policy: Original wording retained. Checked research translations are labelled; no newly recovered unreviewed machine output enters the65-document English model.
counting_notes: The3461figure is completed country-year searches. Downloaded raw byte hashes, reviewed source documents, passages, countries and operative laws are distinct counts. Repeated regional/MoU source across countries is one document, not independent reforms.
